biography.value:
Description

Female doll given life by the mechanical genius, Luca. She uses Brina and her counterpart, Calca, to assist her in battle and in airship repairs.

Defense

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 dex, +4 natural, +1 size)

hp 63 [91] (7d10+21)

mp 21

Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +8

Defensive Abilities Hardness 5, Living-like; Immune construct traits, blind, curse, petrification, silence; Resist fire 10, ice 10, wind 10, earth 10, lightning 10, water 10;

Offense

Speed 20 ft.

Melee Slam +8 (1d4)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Abilities Dance, Divine Seal

Spells Known (FC CL 4th, Concentration +7)

At will - Detect Magic, Holy Orb, Message, Read Magic

1st (DC 14) - Cure, Protect, Shell

2nd (DC 15) - Cure II, Heal

3rd (DC 16) - Cure III, Protect II, Shell II

4th (DC 17) - Cure IV, Healara

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 15, Con -, Int 13, Wis 17, Cha 16

Base Atk +7; CMB +7; CMD 20

Feats Combat Casting, Extend Spell, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

Skills Perception +10, Perform (Dance) +10, Spellcraft +8

description.value: Apply hardness 5.

Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Brina can perform Mystic Dances like the Dancer class can do however without taking attacks of opportunity and does not cost any MP or Ki to use. Brina is limited to up to lvl 7 Mystic Dance and cannot use any that have a prerequisites like Curing Waltz II.

effect: AC -4. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
Land speed +30 feet. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
Heal one ally as Cure at dancer level 7, using Charisma. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
Attack rolls -2. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
Allies' successful melee hits deal an extra 1d4 non-elemental and heal 1d4 HP. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
Dexterity -4. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
Saving throws -3. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.
On a melee hit, stun for one round. No AoO, MP or ki. Timed dance modifiers last three rounds.

description.value: 1/day, Brina can increase the potency of her next healing spell as a swift action, so long as the casting time of the spell is 1 standard action or less. The next healing spell the Brina casts heals for half again as many hit points.

effect: Next healing spell with standard or shorter casting time heals 1.5 times its normal amount.

description.value: Calca gains the benefit of extra hit points from Charisma instead of size due to being a construct which means she can also be healed by normal means. She also gain feats and skills due to having an Intelligence. Her saves are also consider Good unlike most constructs.

effect: Normal healing works. Charisma grants 21 HP instead of size HP. Intelligent construct with good base saves.
